name: asnkitrt
description: Encode and decode ASN.1 with compiled specifications, in the browser and Node.js

scripts.build: cargo build --locked --profile wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p asnkitrt-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/asnkitrt_wasm.wasm
